{{Quote|Nice unit, here... hurls mirth gas grenades the instant you say "''stop, thief!''"|Kitak Hu|<ref name="GW" />}}
A '''mirth gas grenade''' was a weapon for sale at [[Kitak Hu]]'s weapons shop on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It was launched via voice activation, and could be attached to an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] with a [[module harness]]. The grenade exploded into a cloud of [[mirth gas]] which caused attackers to have difficulty breathing.
